matchup.title: Matchup 3: Come-in Cider vs Melbourne poopoo
matchup.plan_md:
**Score 413 to 400 after Monday. Projection as rostered: 1,535 to 1,513, us ahead.**
- Dejounte Murray is off New Orleans' report for Wednesday ([NBC Sports/Rotoworld, 3 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-03/murray-personal-absent-from-injury-report)). ESPN cleared him minutes before this run.
- An earlier run with him listed out projected 1,413 to 1,513.
- The owner keeps VanVleet through his Wednesday game, so his slot opens on Thursday.

**The moves: 3 adds, +89.8, all in VanVleet's slot.** This leaves 2 of our 5 adds spare.

| # | US day | Deadline, Melbourne (ET) | Move |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Thu 5 | **1:00 pm Fri 6** (9:00 pm Thu) | Drop Fred VanVleet, add **Dillon Brooks** (PHX) |
| 2 | Fri 6 | **11:00 am Sat 7** (7:00 pm Fri) | Drop Brooks, add **CJ McCollum** (ATL), for Fri and Sat |
| 3 | Sun 8 | **11:00 am Mon 9** (7:00 pm Sun) | Drop McCollum, add **Jusuf Nurkic** (UTAH) |

- **Dillon Brooks:** 29.4 (5); L7 35.0 (2), which is noise; L15 29.4 (5), L30 29.4 (5). He has started 5 of 5.
  - Monday at GSW: 34 minutes, 18 points and 8 rebounds. He got a technical in the Draymond Green scuffle, and Shams expects no discipline ([Basketball-Reference, 2 Nov](https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202611020GSW.html), [ClutchPoints via Yahoo, 3 Nov](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/shams-gives-warriors-draymond-green-191537330.html)).
  - No suspension has been announced for the 30 Oct Flagrant 2.
  - Thursday against Orlando is the second night of a back-to-back. No rest plan has been reported ([NBA injury report, 3 Nov](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-03_06_00PM.pdf)).
- **CJ McCollum:** 27.4 (8); L7 26.0 (4), L15 27.4 (8), L30 27.4 (8). He has started 8 of 8.
  - Monday at IND: 32 minutes, 13 points, 9 rebounds and 12 assists, with Jalen Johnson out and Kingston Flemings suspended ([Basketball-Reference, 2 Nov](https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202611020IND.html)).
  - Rotoworld expects the bigger playmaking role "likely won't continue" once both are back ([NBC Sports/Rotoworld, 2 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-02/cj-mccollum-tallies-13-9-11-line-vs-indiana)).
  - Johnson is questionable Wednesday (ankle; *ESPN est.* 4 Nov).
  - Atlanta plays a Fri–Sat back-to-back. No rest has been reported for him this season.
- **Jusuf Nurkic is the risk.**
  - He is out again Wednesday at New Orleans ([NBA injury report, 3 Nov](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-03_06_00PM.pdf)).
  - No re-evaluation result, practice report or return date has been found, so ESPN's 4 Nov estimate is stale. SI says "we are around the four-week recovery timeline" ([RotoWire UTA, 3 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/news.php?team=UTA)).
  - **Decide the Sunday add on Saturday** from a fresh run.
  - Sunday alternatives:
    - **Nic Claxton:** upgraded to questionable for Wednesday, with early restrictions likely; Chicago's next game is Sun 8 ([RotoWire, 3 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/nic-claxton-injury-upgraded-to-questionable-537460)); *ESPN est.* 4 Nov.
    - **Santi Aldama:** questionable Wednesday, with a minutes limit expected ([RotoWire, 3 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/santi-aldama-injury-questionable-for-wednesday-537476)); *ESPN est.* 4 Nov.
- **If Brooks and McCollum rest the second nights** (*What-if* below), the best 3-add chain is Bobby Portis, then Toumani Camara, then Nurkic, for +83.8. That is only 6 lower. So the risk does not change the plan, but check each team's report before each move.
- **The 4-add row (+96.8)** gains 7.0 more. It needs Nurkic on Friday and Claxton on Sunday, and both are unconfirmed.

**Lineups.**
- **Wednesday is full** (10 of ours for 10 slots), so start everyone with a game.
- After Wednesday, every day has open slots, so every player with a game starts.
- If **Trey Murphy III** sits Wednesday, the slot is lost. He is probable, with bilateral patellar tendinopathy, after 39:47 on Monday ([NBA injury report, 3 Nov](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-03_06_00PM.pdf)); *ESPN est.* 4 Nov.

**Where it leaves us.** As rostered we are 22 ahead, and the plan adds 89.8 more. Swing factors:
- **Anthony Black** (Thu at PHX, Sat at GSW): rested Monday. No Thursday status yet, and no timetable reported ([NBA injury report, 3 Nov](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-03_06_00PM.pdf)); *ESPN est.* 5 Nov.
- **Dejounte Murray:** expected back Wednesday after three games away. No minutes limit has been reported.
- **Daniel Gafford:** 34.4 (7); L7 38.7 (3), L15 34.4 (7), L30 34.4 (7).
  - He started Monday with 20 points on 9-of-10 shooting ([Basketball-Reference, 2 Nov](https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202611020DAL.html)).
  - Aldama's return, which could come Wednesday on limited minutes, is the threat to his role ([CBS Sports/RotoWire, 2 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/mavericks-daniel-gafford-scores-20-points-in-mondays-loss/)).
- **Kawhi Leonard** (IR): no Tuesday update found. Media access is on Wednesday ([Heavy via Yahoo, 2 Nov](https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/kawhi-leonard-gets-good-news-215427542.html)). Haynes says "around 3 to 4 weeks"; *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
- **Jalen Duren:** out Wednesday. He is due a re-evaluation about 8 Nov ([NBA injury report, 3 Nov](https://ak-static.cms.nba.com/referee/injury/Injury-Report_2026-11-03_06_00PM.pdf)); *ESPN est.* 9 Nov.
- **Melbourne poopoo:**
  - **Ty Jerome** scored 40 in 36 minutes on Monday ([Basketball-Reference, 2 Nov](https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202611020MEM.html)).
  - **Jeremiah Fears's** minutes are threatened by Murray's return ([NBC Sports/Rotoworld, 3 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-03/murray-personal-absent-from-injury-report)).
  - **Anthony Edwards** is out (knee arthroscopy); *ESPN est.* 21 Dec.
  - **Brandon Ingram** was recalled from the G League with no return date ([RotoWire, 2 Nov](https://www.rotowire.com/basketball/headlines/brandon-ingram-injury-returns-from-g-league-assignment-537174)); *ESPN est.* 8 Nov.
- **Trades:**
  - The Foxies declined the Amen Thompson offer.
  - Still pending: Smith Jr. (Black + VanVleet), Harden (Black) and Brunson (Black + VanVleet + Kawhi). They expire 4 Nov at 4:49, 5:18 and 5:29 pm Melbourne.
  - If one executes, Black (and VanVleet, except in the Harden deal) leave, and this plan must be re-run.
